purpose: Learn ScoreStream notation syntax before reading, generating or editing a score. This is the music-format standard, not the MCP tool-call schema.
core_shape: A header, declarations, increasing @time frames, flat records, a dot to commit each frame, and !end at=<position>.

lexical.comments: Whole lines beginning with ; after optional whitespace; no inline comments
lexical.string: JSON-quoted string; JSON escapes; no physical newline inside a token
lexical.whitespace: One or more spaces or tabs separate fields; canonical writer uses one space
lexical.numbers: Attribute type comes from the registry. Musical rational values remain strings in the AST. No duration or pitch inheritance.

defaults.event_kind: note for pitched or unpitched events
defaults.tm: 1:1 when absent; notation can remain unspecified
defaults.no_voice_row: no new event, not a rest
defaults.omitted_state: unchanged; initially unset unless an application profile explicitly supplies a reported default
defaults.event_id: optional only in authoring; committed canonical output assigns IDs and returns the mapping
defaults.written_type: unspecified if w absent; rendering/export may choose a documented spelling and must report inference

scope_rules.collision: Part and voice aliases must be disjoint and cannot be score
scope_rules.precedence: No generic inheritance. Staff transposition tuple replaces the part tuple; absent staff tuple uses part. Assign tuples atomically. Numeric dynamics: staff overrides part; sound=false is display-only.

record_order: Frame records are collected before resolution. State applies at the frame position independent of line order; conflicting assignments fail. Source event order is retained within chord/grace groups. All event references are resolved after collection.
additional_constraints: Transposition assignments contain chromatic, diatonic and octaves together; absent part tuple means zero, absent staff tuple uses the part tuple.
tm_normal_type and tm_normal_dots require tm; actual measured duration and imported written rhythm remain distinct even if inconsistent, with a diagnostic.
Measure targets are part/staff only. Labels are strings; actual length may differ from the nominal meter.
Event-attached marks and relation endpoints occur in the anchor onset frame; frame record order does not affect resolution.
Fragments carry local event IDs, no declarations/state/measure mutations, and no new required extensions; only external voice bindings and supplied context apply.
Unknown extension interpretation must never be inferred from raw-source preservation.

scorestream.barline requires scorestream.navigation@1, a declared part target and exact referenced measure boundary; fragments cannot introduce navigation. Authored-only validation reports unavailable engraving/replay; sounding lowering rejects.

sound_dynamics is an exact nonnegative percentage of forte velocity 90. The bounded numeric playback profile rejects mixtures with sounding symbolic dynamics, hairpins, or attack-changing accents; it never substitutes printed labels.

scorestream.fermata requires scorestream.fermata@1 and a measured note/rest anchor at the exact onset. Keep all distinct part/event copies, authored shape/orientation absence and exact y placement. No hold duration or synchronization is inferred; playback rejects.

scorestream.beam requires scorestream.beam@1 and exact event onset/actual measure ownership. Preserve optional number and value. Full per-lane topology checks include unmarked events; printed beams never alter sounding pitch or time.

time.frame_interval_rule: events start at @t; their score intervals are [t,t+duration)

records.purpose: Start a complete score; declare parts and voices before frames.
Start a bounded local-time replacement. Voice bindings come from the edit request; no part/voice declarations inside.
Declare instrument/staves; optional quoted display_name is plain text, not routing. Missing falls back to instrument; empty stays empty.
Declare a stable voice alias and its default display staff.

records.syntax: !meta title="Example" authors=["A. Author","B. Author"] description="Study" header="Rehearsal" footer="Draft"
records.purpose: Optional plain score text; never a filename fallback or markup. Ordered authors use a JSON string array; legacy composer/lyricist/arranger remain distinct roles. Declare before frames; repeated fields fail.
Declare a mandatory extension. Unknown mandatory semantics cannot be executed as core.
Open a shared-score-time frame; quarter-note unit; exact rational.
One event per line; duration is explicit; no pitch or duration inheritance.
Persistent assignment to an exact scope. No implicit state inheritance.
Attach intrinsic notation or a point mark; analytical prose belongs to the separate future annotation store.
Start/continue/end an identified relation; crossing and nested relations are allowed.
A stable measure ID and actual duration; display label is not identity.
Commit the complete frame atomically; bare EOF never commits.
End a closed document at a declared score position; do not truncate active notes.

staff.meaning: This event only; does not change voice default.

chord.meaning: Membership in a notated chord; members keep independent durations. First member in declared member order is the head.

w.meaning: Written note type; independent of actual duration.

tm.meaning: Actual:normal time modification, such as 3:2. Tuplet graphics are separate relations.

tm_normal_type.meaning: Optional explicitly notated normal note type; maps to written.time_modification.normal_type in typed edits.

tm_normal_dots.meaning: Optional explicitly notated normal dots; maps to written.time_modification.normal_dots. Requires tm.

kind.meaning: Ordinary note is the default. Grace requires duration=?, anchor and nonzero order.

anchor.meaning: Principal note for a grace event; # prefix required.

order.meaning: Grace order relative to principal: negative before, positive after; unique within anchor/group.

visible.meaning: Intrinsic printed visibility; a hidden rest is still a rest.

measure_rest.meaning: Explicit full-measure rest identity, independent of written type. True requires a measured rest spanning its owning explicit actual measure from its start; false and absent are distinct.

notehead.meaning: Core registered notehead token; other glyphs need a registered extension.

note_size.meaning: Graphic size of explicit w; independent of sounding kind and measured duration.

tempo.syntax: w|h|q|e|s, optionally dotted, then colon and positive rational BPM; e.g. q:120, q.:60
tempo.meaning: Tempo unit and rate; printed metronome mark is separate.

meter.meaning: Meter is not elapsed duration. More complex signatures use a registered extension.

key.syntax: signed integer fifths count or unset
key.meaning: Traditional key signature, not inferred tonality.

clef.meaning: Registered clef token. Other variants require registered fields/extensions.

staff.meaning: Change the voice default staff from this position.

sound_dynamics.meaning: Explicit numeric playback dynamics as a percentage of MIDI-relative forte 90; separate from printed dynamics. Exact storage; no label substitution.

tie.end_semantics: The next written note head; sounding continuity must be validated.

slur.end_semantics: The linked terminal event; may cross other slurs.

placement.meaning: Without scorestream.slur@1 this retains legacy immutable relation semantics. With the capability it is independently optional on each endpoint and is distinct from curvature orientation.

bezier_x.meaning: Exact authored MusicXML horizontal Bézier control-point coordinate in tenths relative to this endpoint. Start supplies control point 1; end supplies control point 2. Independently optional; never infer zero or the missing partner.

bezier_y.meaning: Exact authored MusicXML vertical Bézier control-point coordinate in tenths relative to this endpoint. Start supplies control point 1; end supplies control point 2. Independently optional; never infer zero or the missing partner.

orientation.meaning: Endpoint-authored curvature orientation, distinct from above/below placement; absence remains absence.

slur.authored_profile: scorestream.slur@1 reuses native relation IDs and exactly start/end anchors. Only bezier_x, bezier_y, orientation and placement are permitted and are per-endpoint, never immutable across the relation. line_type and continue are unsupported in this profile but remain valid legacy SFS.

tuplet.end_semantics: Last member inclusive of its duration; per-note tm remains independent.

crescendo.end_semantics: Anchored span; performance interpretation is explicit.

diminuendo.end_semantics: Anchored span; performance interpretation is explicit.

pedal.end_semantics: Pedal span/control anchors; partial pedals require an appropriate registered model.

lyric_extend.end_semantics: Lyric extension ending at an explicit event.

title.meaning: Explicit score title. Never inferred from a filename, application name, header or description.

description.meaning: Catalog/editor description; not automatically printed as notation or a page title.

header.meaning: Optional running page-header text, independent of the title; no markup or template expansion.

footer.meaning: Optional running page-footer text; no markup or template expansion.

subtitle.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

composer.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

lyricist.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

arranger.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

work_number.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

movement.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

rights.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

language.meaning: Optional plain score text; no markup interpretation. Empty strings are retained. Control characters other than tab/LF/CR are preserved with a portability warning; exporters must diagnose unsupported text, not silently discard it.

authors.meaning: Ordered plain names. JSON string array; horizontal whitespace allowed inside the array. Nonblank single-line names without control characters. Empty or absent means none. Do not infer roles or merge with composer/lyricist/arranger.

id.meaning: Stable text mark identity; map to opaque object ID in API responses

sound.meaning: False preserves printed dynamics without assigning performer-policy loudness.

measure.meaning: Authored measure identity in target part; never a display label.

times.meaning: Authored bounded 32-bit count; only backward repeats without endings. Zero cannot form a supported route.

passes.meaning: Comma-separated distinct positive 32-bit pass numbers; at most 1024; required with ending.

ending_text.meaning: Printed display override, separate from pass selection.

ending_y.meaning: Exact authored vertical placement in tenths, not playback state.

source_id.meaning: Optional preserved authored barline identity; not a generated SFS mark identity.

scorestream.barline.meaning: Authored-only per-part boundary. Frame equals referenced measure start/end. Scope is a declared part; neither score nor staff/voice/event. Duplicate part/measure/side fails; generic mark id is unsupported. Ending data requires ending and passes; times requires backward repeat. Playback lowering rejects until performed replay exists.

shape.meaning: Absent preserves empty MusicXML normal shape; explicit normal remains explicit.

orientation.meaning: Absent preserves the implicit upright default, not a duration or staff placement.

default_y.meaning: Exact authored vertical position in tenths.

relative_y.meaning: Exact authored vertical adjustment in tenths.

scorestream.fermata.meaning: Authored-only measured event annotation; target is #note-or-rest at its exact onset. One sign per event. No duration, global hold, repeat projection or silent once-through approximation.

steal_previous.meaning: Exact authored percent from the preceding note, 0 through 100; not realized.

steal_following.meaning: Exact authored percent from the following note, 0 through 100; not realized.

make_time.meaning: Exact nonnegative quarter-equivalent amount scaled from MusicXML divisions; timing intent, not measured duration.

scorestream.grace.meaning: One metadata record per authored pitched grace event, including empty timing intent. Requires duration=?, kind=grace, same-frame/voice/staff non-chord pitched principal, consecutive order=-N..-1; slash absence is retained. Performance rejects rather than omitting attacks.

volume.meaning: Exact channel volume percent 0..100, distinct from note velocity.

scorestream.instrument.meaning: One initial single-instrument declaration per part at zero. Source ID, Unicode labels and standard sound identity remain separate from catalog key and pitch. Device string presence retains even an empty element; absent port remains absent. device_ref and midi_ref match source_id. MIDI source numbers are one-based. No multiple declarations, guessing, sample or device activation; authored MIDI intent blocks playback until explicit realization.

number.meaning: Optional authored level 1 through 8; absence remains distinct from explicit 1.

value.meaning: Native SFS hook atoms map exactly to the spaced MusicXML/common-model values forward hook and backward hook. Run tokens are unchanged.

scorestream.beam.meaning: Printed authored beam at the exact event onset. Requires explicit written flags, unique effective levels, all lower levels and closed contiguous same-measure/voice/staff runs. Secondary connections must also connect at lower levels. Secondary hooks preserve local direction without inferred neighbor attachment. Measured pitched chords require consecutive ordered members with identical actual duration, full explicit written rhythm, graphic size and effective lane; stems must all be absent or equal up/down. The first declared member alone owns beams. Members remain separate events. Member beams, mixed rhythm/staff/stem, ambiguous groups and grace chords reject. Primary hooks, semantic cues, unpitched/spacer targets, cross-measure runs and mixing legacy beam relations reject. Grace beams require the authored before-principal profile. Graphic cue size remains sounding. No performance timing changes.

semantic_rules.rule: Every frame is explicitly closed by a single dot line before a new frame or !end.
Core frame times strictly increase. Equal time belongs to the same frame; multi-clock semantics require an extension.
Timing rationals are reduced with a positive denominator. Ordinary notes, rests and spacers have positive duration.

Aliases, object references, staff numbers and required extensions must resolve; IDs are unique in their declared namespace. Part and voice aliases are disjoint; score is reserved. External opaque object IDs use returned text-ID mappings.
Pitch spelling is authoritative. F#4 is not a request to print an accidental. No duplicate authoritative MIDI/spelling fields.
Missing voice rows mean no new event. Sustained notes derive from intervals; r is a rest and _ is an invisible spacer.
Voice identity is independent from staff. An event staff override affects only that event.
Chord membership is explicit; simultaneous notes in different voices are not silently merged. Chord member lengths may differ.
Written type/dots, per-note time modification and visible tuplet relations remain separate.
State scopes and types follow the registry. Conflicting simultaneous assignments without explicit ordering fail.
Relations resolve after reading the whole frame; continuations at an extracted boundary require supplied context.
A complete core score ends no earlier than all measured event tails and declared measure ends.
Fragments use local [0,span) onset coordinates, end=span, external voice bindings and no global state/measure declarations.
A preserve-duration region replacement must cover its declared voice intervals using notes, rests or spacers and cannot silently alter crossing relations.
Analytical comments/effect descriptions are independent annotation records, never intrinsic score marks unless intentionally authored notation.
Unknown unqualified fields are errors. Namespaced content must be declared and is marked interpreted or preserved-only.
Core coverage does not imply complete MusicXML semantic support. Conversion reports separately track structure, interpreted meaning, preserved payload and target limitations.
A change to an immutable revision is a new transaction. Stale edit or visual selection references are never silently retargeted.

extensions.unknown_required_behavior: preserve for inspection if possible, reject semantic operations requiring that extension

scorestream.navigation@1.status: authored notation roundtrip; no performed realization
scorestream.navigation@1.required_behavior: Exactly one capability declaration with at least one boundary. Unknown versions reject. Conversion supports ordinary closed routes; unclosed final endings fail without a separate explicit policy. No silent once-through playback or invented ending closure.

scorestream.fermata@1.status: authored event annotation roundtrip; no performed realization
scorestream.fermata@1.required_behavior: Exactly one capability with at least one anchored sign. Measured notes/rests only; grace/spacer/barline anchors and multiple signs per event reject. Timing and engraving unavailable. Playback rejects until explicit global interpretation policy exists.

scorestream.grace@1.required_behavior: One capability and one metadata record per grace event. Only pitched before-principal non-chord groups. All timing values are retained without inference. Legacy SFS grace without this capability is unchanged.

scorestream.instrument@1.status: single-instrument identity and initial MIDI intent roundtrip
scorestream.instrument@1.required_behavior: One capability with at least one initial part record. Unknown sounds/names without an exact reviewed catalog projection reject. Broader catalog mappings retain source subtype and report normalization. Any MIDI record requires an explicit playback route realization; plain identity metadata preserves existing catalog playback, including explicit later SFS instrument states (which remain unsupported by the MusicXML adapter).

scorestream.beam@1.status: authored printed beam roundtrip; no sounding effect
scorestream.beam@1.required_behavior: One capability with at least one valid event-attached beam in a complete score. Preserve number absence and all five lexical values. Evaluate every event, including unmarked intervening events. Full validation precedes sound-neutral lowering; existing grace, fermata, navigation and instrument performance guards remain unchanged. Legacy SFS beam relations without this capability are unchanged.

scorestream.slur@1.status: authored slur endpoint roundtrip; performance unavailable
scorestream.slur@1.required_behavior: One capability with at least one valid slur in a complete score. Reuse stable native relation IDs, with exactly one start and one end per ID; parallel relations with distinct IDs remain distinct. Anchors must be distinct pitched events in one part; cross-voice and cross-staff are allowed. Start onset precedes end, except strictly ordered genuine before-principal grace events in the same principal group using authored negative order (including grace to principal). Never infer order from IDs or record order. Exact optional endpoint Bézier coordinates, orientation and placement are independent and no defaults are inferred. Source-local XML numbers may be regenerated with an explicit normalization report. Reject malformed fields, continues, line_type, resting/unpitched/silent-cue anchors, unknown versions and missing capability for new fields. Every ordinary or qualified performance lowering rejects this capability until an explicit supported policy exists. Legacy SFS slurs without it are unchanged.

editing.cross_boundary_default: reject unless an explicit supported relation operation resolves it
editing.ripple: not accepted in this core contract
editing.identity: use returned score_id, revision_id, selection_id and object IDs

examples.name: document-metadata
examples.source:
!score 1.1 unit=q
!part p instrument=piano staves=1
!voice v part=p staff=1
!meta title="春日练习" description="两位作者的短练习曲。" authors=["林青", "Alex Chen"]
!meta header="排练版" footer="仅供学习 · 2026"
@0
= score tempo=q:100
= p.s1 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=G2
| p m1 len=4 label="1"
v C4:2 id=a w=2
.
@2
v E4:2 id=b w=2
.
!end at=4

examples.name: ensemble
examples.source:
!score 1.1 unit=q
!part p instrument=piano staves=2
!part v instrument=violin staves=1
!voice pr part=p staff=1
!voice pl part=p staff=2
!voice vn part=v staff=1
@0
= score tempo=q:120
= p.s1 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=G2
= p.s2 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=F4
= v.s1 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=G2
| p pm1 len=4 label="1"
| v vm1 len=4 label="1"
pr C4:1 id=n1 chord=c1
pr E4:1 id=n2 chord=c1
pr G4:1 id=n3 chord=c1
pl C3:4 id=n4
vn C5:2 id=n5
.
@1
pr D4:1 id=n6 chord=c2
pr F4:1 id=n7 chord=c2
pr A4:1 id=n8 chord=c2
.
@2
pr E4:2 id=n9 chord=c3
pr G4:2 id=n10 chord=c3
pr B4:2 id=n11 chord=c3
vn D5:2 id=n12
.
!end at=4

examples.name: tuplets-and-ties
examples.source:
!score 1.1 unit=q
!part v instrument=violin staves=1
!voice vn part=v staff=1
@0
= v.s1 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=G2
| v vm1 len=4 label="1"
vn C5:1/3 id=a w=8 tm=3:2
~ tuplet u1 start=#a actual=3 normal=2
.
@1/3
vn D5:1/3 id=b w=8 tm=3:2
.
@2/3
vn E5:1/3 id=c w=8 tm=3:2
~ tuplet u1 end=#c
.
@1
vn r:2 id=r1 w=2
.
@3
vn F5:1 id=d w=4
~ tie t1 start=#d sound=true print=true
.
@4
| v vm2 len=4 label="2"
vn F5:1 id=e w=4
~ tie t1 end=#e
.
@5
vn r:3 id=r2 w=2 dots=1
.
!end at=8

examples.name: replacement-fragment
examples.source:
!fragment 1.1 unit=q span=4
@0
mel C5:1 id=f1
.
@1
mel D5:1 id=f2
.
@2
mel E5:2 id=f3
.
!end at=4

examples.name: grace-percussion-cross-staff
examples.source:
!score 1.1 unit=q
!part p instrument=piano staves=2
!part d instrument=drums staves=1
!voice pr part=p staff=1
!voice dr part=d staff=1
@0
= p.s1 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=G2
= p.s2 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=F4
= d.s1 meter=4/4 key=0 clef=percussion
| p pm1 len=4 label="1"
| d dm1 len=4 label="1"
pr D5:? id=g1 kind=grace anchor=#a order=-1 w=8 slash=true
pr C5:2 id=a w=2
+ #a articulation value=staccato
dr u.snare:1 id=hit1
.
@1
dr r:3 id=rest1 w=2 dots=1
.
@2
pr C4:2 id=b staff=2 w=2
.
!end at=4

validation_boundary: JSON Schema checks the parsed AST only. The lexer/parser enforces EBNF; the semantic validator enforces timing, references, scope, relation and conversion constraints.
next_actions: Inspect the target score and pin its revision.
Read a region and keep its frozen selection and boundary context.
Return a valid bounded fragment or typed domain operations.
Apply with expected_revision_id and idempotency_key; re-read after a conflict.
